changes.evidence: src/ui/zoom.test.ts (14 tests: wheel factor reproduces Chrome's -100·ln(scale) pinch encoding, a mouse notch is capped to 1.2x, free values survive parse/format); npm run typecheck clean; verify:showcase ui 15/15 steps, 0 console errors, 0 warnings (step 10: three ctrl+wheel notches take 50 % to 86 % around bar 6; step 11: synthetic two-finger pinch lands on exactly 150 % with the viewport centre held, scrollTop 277); npm run verify 28/28 checks
openIssues: Touch pinch and Safari gesture paths are exercised with synthetic events in headless Chrome only; not yet tried on a physical touch screen or in desktop Safari
A pinch that begins after a one-finger scroll is already under way cannot cancel that scroll (touchmove is no longer cancelable), so the page scrolls and zooms together until the fingers lift
Wheel/pinch zoom deliberately does not pull the playing bar back into view while auto-scroll is on; the next bar change does
